text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Time came back, but not where we expected.** Reps saved about 40 minutes a day on CRM updates. Most of it went to prep, not extra calls.

**2. Customers noticed the follow-ups.** Recap emails went out the same day, with their exact words quoted. Replies got faster.

**3. Consent matters.** Asking up front took ten seconds and built trust. Skipping it nearly cost us a deal.

**4. Managers gained coaching material.** Call snippets beat memory-based feedback every time.

**5. Adoption took habit, not mandate.** Reps who reviewed summaries daily stuck with it.

The tool didn't make anyone a better seller. It removed the busywork that was hiding good selling.

What did your team learn?
